repo_notes.content:
sfn-diagram is a TypeScript library and CLI that renders AWS Step Functions state machines as SVG, Mermaid, HTML or PNG diagrams.

AGENTS.md is the authoritative summary of the public API: the entry points (sfn-diagram, /png, /aws, /cfn, /terraform, /ci, /element, /element/auto), which runtimes each supports, the single-object-parameter calling convention and common mistakes. Follow it over guesses from file names.

The repo is a monorepo. The root package (src/) is the library and CLI. packages/sfn-diagram-react is a React wrapper, packages/vscode-sfn-diagram the VS Code extension, packages/github-action-sfn-diagram the GitHub Action, and site/ the Astro Starlight docs site with a browser playground (sfn.yusufaf.dev).

The rendering pipeline is: parse ASL into a graph (src/AslParser.ts, src/graph/), lay it out with dagre plus catch lanes and orthogonal routing (src/layout/), then render (src/renderers/). The SVG renderer builds strings without a DOM, so the core runs in Node, browsers and edge runtimes.

Ignore generated and build output: src/renderers/viewer/*.generated.ts, custom-elements.json, packages/*/dist, tests/__snapshots__ and CHANGELOG.md files.

Releases are automated with release-please, one component per package. Nobody bumps versions or publishes by hand.
